title: BW ESS acquires 250MW / 1000MWh Yanco BESS from ACEnergy
text:
New South Wales, Australia, 13 August 2026 –Global energy storage owner-operator, BW ESS, has acquired the Yanco Battery Energy Storage System (Yanco BESS) from leading Australian renewable energy developer ACEnergy. BW ESS will now move the 250MW / 1,000MWh project in Riverina, New South Wales through construction and into long-term operations.
